verdict.rationale: A guided first-time workspace setup is a fair question for an issue-tracking SaaS like Linear, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an onboarding walkthrough. 'Guided Reviews' covers code-diff review, and the toolchain auto-install covers agent coding sessions, so neither addresses user workspace onboarding.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
